shadows_of_the_market.title: Shadows in the Market
shadows_of_the_market.description: Hooded figures have been seen around the old warehouse at the edge of the market. Violet believes they are cultists - and that someone is supplying them from inside the city.
shadows_of_the_market.objective: Defeat Vargas and break up the cult cell in the old warehouse.

vargas_debt.title: A Debt to Collect
vargas_debt.description: Mirt says Vargas has stopped paying an important debt and now hides in the old warehouse. Mirt wants him reminded of his moral responsibility.
vargas_debt.objective: Find Vargas in the old warehouse and collect Mirt's debt.

violet_warning.title: A Word of Warning
violet_warning.description: Violet wants Mirt warned about the hooded figures before he does business with the wrong people.
violet_warning.objective: Carry Violet's warning to Mirt in the tavern.

sentinel_sigil.title: The Sentinel's Sigil
sentinel_sigil.description: Mirt has heard of a sealed vault beneath the old warehouse, guarded by an iron sentinel. He wants the relic inside brought back to him.
sentinel_sigil.objective: Recover Sentinel's Edge from the Sealed Vault beneath the warehouse.

waystation_trouble.title: Trouble on the Trade Road
waystation_trouble.description: Mirt's caravans have stopped using the eastern trade road. A bandit chief has taken the Broken Waystation and is taxing anyone who survives the journey.
waystation_trouble.objective: Clear the Broken Waystation at the end of the Trade Road.

bounty_goblin_road.title: Goblin Toll
bounty_goblin_road.description: Goblin scouts have been shaking down travellers on the trade road.

bounty_wolf_cull.title: Wolf Cull
bounty_wolf_cull.description: A pair of wolves has been stalking the road and the market outskirts.

bounty_waystation_chief.title: The Waystation Contract
bounty_waystation_chief.description: The bounty board will pay well for the bandit chief holding the Broken Waystation.

underroad_chapter.title: The Underroad
underroad_chapter.description: The bandit chief's ledger points to a hidden route beneath the Broken Waystation, where a Smuggler Lord is moving goods and paying for silence.
underroad_chapter.objective: Descend into the Underroad and defeat the Smuggler Lord.
